1.Sub-event_summary: XIX Corps to contain east of Vire, support VII Corps; V Corps diversionary attack D+2. VII Corps modifications: added 4th Infantry Division to assault (due to 9th/30th exhaustion); rerouted exploitation—1st Infantry (with 3d Armored CCB) direct to Coutances; reduced 3d Armored wider envelopment; 2d Armored (with 4th Division's 22d RCT) to left blocking at le Mesnil-Herman/Villebaudon/Tessy-sur-Vire and Cérences, providing VIII Corps corridor.

7.Sub-event_summary: Before dawn on 29 July, German breakout attempts strike American positions near Notre-Dame-de-Cenilly and elsewhere. Key engagements include a crossroads battle where a self-propelled gun is disabled, and an outpost overrun near the 78th Armored Field Artillery Battalion that is repelled with artillery direct fire. Small groups filter through, but the cordon largely holds.
